subject: [PATCH v2 3/4] fs/proc/task_mmu: don't read young/dirty from a non-present PMD in smaps

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's /proc/PID/smaps functionality where it incorrectly reads young and dirty bits from non-present PMDs, leading to incorrect accounting of memory usage. The issue was caused by passing these bits to smaps_account() for all PMDs, including softleaf entries, without checking if the entry is present. The patch fixes this by only reading the young and dirty bits when the PMD is present, preventing incorrect accounting and potential crashes due to garbage values being returned.
